title: AI Agentic Web Emerges as Structural Shift While Security Risks and Geopolitical Threats Intensify
core_insight: AI生态系统正从孤立任务求解向自主交互的Agentic Web演进，但伴随出现的安全风险和地缘政治威胁标志着产业进入高风险高增长阶段

dimension_texts.technology: AI agent系统从孤立任务求解向持久化数字实体演进，Holos论文提出Web规模的多agent系统，标志着Agentic Web生态系统的出现 神经符号推理架构结合神经网络的感知能力和符号系统的组合泛化，为复杂推理任务提供新范式 Holos: A Web-Scale LLM-Based Multi-Agent System for the Agentic Web Compositional Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning Single-Agent LLMs Outperform Multi-Agent Systems on Multi-Hop Reasoning Under Equal Thinking Token Budgets
dimension_texts.infrastructure: WebGPU在浏览器端LLM推理的调度开销得到系统量化，为边缘计算优化提供基准；LLM文本压缩技术实现10倍压缩增益 Anthropic与Google、Broadcom合作建设多GW级下一代计算基础设施，显示算力军备竞赛升级 Characterizing WebGPU Dispatch Overhead for LLM Inference Across Four GPU Vendors Haiku to Opus in Just 10 bits: LLMs Unlock Massive Compression Gains Anthropic expands partnership with Google and Broadcom for multiple gigawatts of next-generation compute
dimension_texts.application: AI深入文化遗产保护、聚合物分子动力学模拟、电网韧性规划等专业领域，显示垂直行业渗透加速 Google推出离线AI听写应用挑战传统语音识别方案，ChatGPT应用集成扩展至DoorDash、Spotify等日常服务 PolyJarvis: LLM Agent for Autonomous Polymer MD Simulations Competency Questions as Executable Plans: a Controlled RAG Architecture for Cultural Heritage Storytelling Google quietly launched an AI dictation app that works offline
